notes.title: Octane Remix Version 1.2.0
notes.notes: [p]Long time no see, Dome Racers! It is time for a new feature update, containing new things for both cars and tracks:[/p][list][*][p]The desert biome versions of all tracks have been updated with unique visuals, such as many more towering monoliths and expansive sand dunes.[/p][/*][*][p]A new feature has been added to all cars: by driving close to top speed, you can now start to temporarily push beyond the limits of the car, increasing as long as you don't slow down. Losing momentum also means losing some or all of this limit override.,[/p][/*][*][p]Something large is now lurking in the depths of the dome; you might see it in the distance if you spend enough time there.[/p][/*][*][p]Some tracks are now longer, with more tubes and other unusual driving challenges.[/p][/*][*][p]Sparks now fly when drifting Ichigo (Michishige's car) close to corners and slamming the car after jumps.[/p][/*][*][p]There are now holographic indicators for when Chipembere (Akash's car) is being pushed sideways away from walls,[/p][/*][*][p]The camera in the hub has been updated to be both smoother and quicker to follow the cursor.[/p][/*][*][p]Some tweaks have been made to the off-track reset system, which should reduce the risk of falling off track immediately after resetting.[/p][/*][*][p]Text readability has been improved on multiple UI modules,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the "time dilation" active skill could get prematurely cancelled by pausing the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where some of the players who had completed the tutorial could not access it again[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 is live!
notes.notes:
It is time for another game update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442582/2d2845ad55919e763dfab8c35eebde8ec6d5ae84.gif[/img]

Version 1.1.1 brings a few QoL improvements:
[list]
[*]the ability to rebind keys has been added, you are now able to customize your driving controls to your liking
[*]a new animated exit sequence has been added right before exiting a "pitstop", such as after choosing an upgrade or a map node
[*]a rarely occurring run-ending bug has been squashed, there should no longer be any risk of getting teleported back to the start of a piece of road over and over again
[*]some texts in the garage have been altered for much improved readability
[*]the sound of the "handbrake hop" active skill no longer plays multple times when it shouldn't, it also no longer continues playing after releasing of the skill button
[/list]

notes.title: Update to Octane Remix - 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Update 1.1.0 is here, get ready for an enhanced gaming experience!

We've been hard at work addressing some of the most requested fixes and improvements. Here are the main issues that have been resolved and improved:

[list]
[*] Sleek HUD Bars, now smoother and more visually polished.
[*] More consistent camera movement, tailored to your screen resolution, in the hub area.
[*] Minor typos removed in the upgrades menu.
[*] Upgrades text now stands out better, with improved color grading. 
[*] Campaign nodes now come with helpful descriptions to give you a better understanding of your journey.
[*] Additional animations and SFX added to campaign map and Exit countdown.
[*] A Rear view mirror animation bug has been resolved
[*] Gamepad controls in the level editor have been revamped for a smoother experience.
[*] Manual Camera rotation added to the Level Editor, available for both mouse/keyboard and gamepad users.
[*] Exiting a run through the pause menu will no longer sometimes make play button resume instead.
[*] Warmup Clarity: The warmup lap now features added UI elements, providing you with a clear view of your progress.
[/list]

Update now and dive back into the action with these fantastic improvements! Thank you for your continued support and feedback - keep it coming!

Yours, 
Team Velocita

notes.title: Octane Remix Patch 19/07-23
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

First of all, thank you so much to everyone that has played Octane Remix, as well as sharing your feedback and bug issues with us! We at Team Velocita are so thankful to each and everyone of you. 

Since launch we have been working hard on ironing out some bugs and issues that have been popping up. Here are the issues that will be resolved with this patch:

[list]
[*] Ghost Frames have been shrunk and made less distracting.
[*] Fixed some bugs that cause soft locks in the racing mode.
[*] Steam Deck fatal error which lead to players not being able to launch the game is fixed.
[/list] 

There are still some issues with the game that we have not had the time to flatten just yet, here are a few known ones:

[list]
[*] Level editor & Roadmap delayed by another week due to fatal bug.
[*] Main menu video not shown on Linux platforms.
[*] Steam Deck only: New Heat Bar is blurry
[/list] 

We will be coming out ASAP with more patches and updates regarding the game, so stay tuned for more! 

Yours,
Team Velocita

notes.title: Devblog: A pivot
notes.notes:
Good day everyone, we hope this last week has treated you well! 
While we don’t usually release Dev blogs, due to some recent major changes to Octane Remix we feel that it would be warranted. 

Initially, like most teams do when working on games they have passion for, we had a grand vision for Octane Remix. However with time we have come to realize that our scope compared to our time and resources was far too large, forcing us to rescope. 

As a result, we’ve re-evaluated what was the core to our game and what was more along the lines of a wishlist. We have elected to remove the story mode from the game, in favor of a randomly generated career-type of mode. This still allows us to provide you with a highly engaging Roguelite-Racing experience, as well as the high modability which we aimed for, while at the same time not having to spend our limited resources making a story that leaves the players less than satisfied. 

The reason for our design choice in this matter stems all the way back to what Octane Remix was originally supposed to be. A moddable, Roguelite Racing experience. Yes, we wanted a story, but the core was always the roguelite-racing combination, a combination which we felt there wasn’t enough of on the market. Unfortunately, however, we are a small team, with not enough members of our team able to split their focus to work on writing. Because our end goal is to ultimately provide you with a high-energy fast-paced experience, based on our design axioms (which we may dive deeper into in a future post), we ended up making the hard decision to cut that part of our concept. 

We appreciate that quite a few of you looked forward to the story mode, and so did we. However, Team V and I sincerely hope that you will continue to support our game’s development process going forward and that you try out our upcoming demo (more on that in a future post). 

Best Regards,
Team Velocita
